data.name: Nouf
data.gender_notes: Nouf is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nuf’, which means ‘soft’, ‘gentle’, or ‘breeze’. In Islamic culture, Nouf represents the subtle, delicate, and soothing aspects of life. The name Nouf carries the meaning “Soft, gentle breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nouf usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Nouf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nouf total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
